description: Segment fully automated SoRs divided by total fully automated SoRs across all platform-category segments.
relevance: Measures each platform-category segment's share of total fully automated moderation exposure.

description: Cumulative automated exposure share after sorting platform-category segments from highest to lowest exposure.
relevance: Shows how concentrated fully automated moderation exposure is among the highest-volume segments.

description: Number of selected platforms reporting the broad violation category.
relevance: Describes cross-platform category coverage.

description: Minimum fully automated moderation rate observed across platforms for a category.
relevance: Lower bound used to measure cross-platform variation within a category.

description: Maximum fully automated moderation rate observed across platforms for a category.
relevance: Upper bound used to measure cross-platform variation within a category.

description: Difference between the maximum and minimum fully automated moderation rate across platforms within a category.
relevance: Quantifies cross-platform variation in automation exposure.

description: Median fully automated rate of other selected platforms reporting the same category, excluding the focal platform.
relevance: Provides the leave-one-platform-out same-category peer benchmark.

description: Number of peer platforms contributing to the leave-one-platform-out median.
relevance: Reports the amount of peer support behind each divergence estimate.

description: Focal platform fully automated rate minus the leave-one-platform-out same-category peer median.
relevance: Preserves the direction of deviation from same-category peers.

description: Absolute value of signed peer divergence.
relevance: Measures the magnitude of same-category peer divergence irrespective of direction.

description: True when absolute peer divergence exceeds 0.25.
relevance: Operational flag for segments with more than 25 percentage-point divergence from peers.

description: Start date of the preceding observation within the same platform-category series.
relevance: Supports verification of exact seven-day temporal adjacency.

description: Represented SoR volume of the previous weekly observation in the same platform-category series.
relevance: Used with current-week volume to determine whether a week-to-week comparison is reliable.

description: Current week's fully automated rate minus the previous week's fully automated rate for the same platform-category series.
relevance: Primary signed measure of week-over-week automation-rate change.

description: Absolute value of the week-over-week automation-rate change.
relevance: Measures operational magnitude of temporal change and is also an RQ4 model feature.

description: Number of days between the current and previous weekly observations in the same series.
relevance: Ensures temporal comparisons use exactly seven-day adjacency.

description: Number of reliable week-to-week comparisons available for the platform-category series under the selected volume threshold.
relevance: Determines whether a series satisfies the minimum 12-comparison eligibility rule.

description: Within-series robust temporal score calculated as 0.6745 times change minus median change divided by MAD.
relevance: Identifies changes unusual relative to the platform-category series' own temporal behavior.

description: True when absolute robust change score is at least 3.5 and absolute automation change is at least 0.10.
relevance: Operational temporal-instability signal requiring both statistical unusualness and material change.

description: Same-week same-category leave-one-platform-out median fully automated rate among eligible RQ4 observations.
relevance: Provides the weekly peer benchmark used to construct RQ4 peer divergence.

description: Number of peer platforms contributing to the same-week same-category peer median.
relevance: Reports support behind the weekly peer comparison.

description: Absolute difference between the focal observation's fully automated rate and the same-week same-category leave-one-platform-out peer median.
relevance: One of the six Isolation Forest features.

description: Natural logarithm of one plus represented SoR volume.
relevance: Volume feature transformed to reduce scale dominance in the multivariate model.

description: Number of the ten Isolation Forest runs in which the observation appears in the top-20 audit-priority list.
relevance: Primary measure of selection stability across random seeds.

description: True when an observation appears in the top-20 list in at least 8 of 10 Isolation Forest runs.
relevance: Defines the final stable audit-priority shortlist.

description: Mean negative Isolation Forest decision-function score across the ten seeded runs, oriented so higher values indicate greater audit priority.
relevance: Provides a continuous audit-priority score for ranking observations.

description: Rank of the mean anomaly score, with rank 1 representing the highest audit priority.
relevance: Provides an operational ordering of candidate observations.

description: RQ4 feature with the largest absolute robust-scaled deviation for the observation.
relevance: Provides transparent feature context without claiming causal model attribution.

description: Absolute robust-scaled magnitude of the observation's largest-deviation feature.
relevance: Quantifies the strength of the reported feature-level contextual deviation.
